s1.text:
WHAT CHANGES

• Login: the empty top half becomes the brand (logo, tricolour rule, live market line). Labels sit above fields. Language switch on the first screen.
• Lock setup: explains what the lock does; fingerprint first; "Not now" is a quiet text button.
• Lock: greets you by name; one bank-form box per PIN digit; the error line has a fixed slot so the keypad never jumps; fingerprint on the keypad.

s2.text:
WHAT CHANGES

• Same layout, same two taps. Chart keeps most of the screen.
• Balance in Indian grouping (₹9,99,600.00), labelled "Demo balance".
• Amount written in words under the figure, like a cheque (stops a stray zero).
• Buy/Sell become Up/Down with arrows and show what you get back if you win.
• Open trade reads like a pending passbook entry.
• Trade length sheet shows the exact time the trade ends.

s3.text:
WHAT CHANGES

• Your trades: a small ledger (time, trade, result) with Won/Lost rubber stamps and a day total.
• Markets: category chips (Crypto, India, Forex, starred), price + change per row, closed markets say so with their opening time.
• Deposit bonus: a plain table, gold only on the next tier; the withdrawal rule stays in words above the button.

s4.text:
MONEY FLOWS

• Payments: the account as a passbook cover; withdrawable vs bonus split.
• Deposit: amount + words, bonus earned, then the UPI app.
• UPI pay: QR, installed-app buttons, auto status.
• Receipt: perforated, stamped CREDITED, UTR, new balance.
• Withdraw: limits up front, prefilled UPI ID, amount repeated on the button.
Names, amounts, IDs and the VPA are examples.

s5.text:
HISTORY + ACCOUNT

• History is a real passbook page: Particulars, Debit, Credit, running Balance, grouped by day.
• Payment detail: tracking timeline; held withdrawal can be cancelled.
• Account: identity + KYC stamp, settings in three short groups.
• Verify identity: the four steps listed up front.
• Document photo: card-shaped saffron guide, torch, gallery fallback.

s6.text:
PROMPTS

• Notifications: asked after the first Live trade ends, never at launch, with a preview of the notification.
• Update required: what happened, that the balance is safe, one action. Maintenance and VPN blocked reuse this pattern.
